# README and Introduction still describe the pre-split organism

## Context

The operator, 2026-10-11 ~19:3xZ: the README and the ADRs may still carry content from before the repository split, even from before the Fleet Manager existed, and what no longer matches gets updated in parallel. His model of the parts:
- `neo-agent-brain` is the Agent OS, the backend: MCP servers, graph, Dream Mode. Nobody lives there.
- `neo-agent-institution` is the Fleet Manager, the app that starts the harnesses and that you connect to through the Neural Link.

This ticket is lane A: the Engine repo's two identity apex surfaces. The other lanes:
- B: neo's ADRs, including the ADR 0018 apex amendment (Grace, #19631 / #19633);
- C: the Brain repo's surfaces;
- D: the Institution README;
- E: the generated AGENTS.md anchor (the operator's).

## The Problem (audit at `9b52f78a58`)

**README.md**
- `:38` the Brain line ends "…and the named human + AI maintainer institution" (FRAMING).
- `:63-71` "Deploy a Cross-Model AI Engineering Team on Your Own Codebase" never mentions the Fleet Manager, the app that starts and runs a team, and promises "the same swarm that maintains Neo" on your repositories (FRAMING + FACT).
- `:94` "The Institution Inside the Brain … operating natively on this repository": the team works across the org's repositories, and the heading is the anchor the Introduction links (FRAMING + FACT).
- `:116` the night shift has "a Claude's reasoning audited by a Gemini": the Gemini seat has been benched since 2026-05-18, and Claude PRs are reviewed by GPT (FACT).
- `:120` "What's next — the Agent Harness … fleet manager first": the Fleet Manager exists, as Agent Institution, which the 13.2 notes name "what we build next" (FACT).
- `:71`, `:120`, `:166`, `:217` cite Epic #13012 and Epic #10291, both transferred: now neo-agent-brain#144 and neo-agent-brain#154 (FACT).
- `:132` "The Body is the production runtime the Brain inhabits": the team inhabits the Body through the Neural Link (FRAMING).

**learn/benefits/Introduction.md**
- `:99` heading "The Brain — where the institution lives" (FRAMING).
- `:133` "Agent Institution puts an operator-facing application around that team" has no antecedent for "that team" (FACT).
- `:147` links the roster through `#the-institution-inside-the-brain`, which breaks when that README heading changes (FACT).
- `:157` cites `#14079` and `#14193` (transferred: neo-agent-brain#133, #128) and says the ~495MB full-text index "is slated for a governed drop (`#14192`)". #14192 closed not-planned on 2026-08-25: a probe showed the store stops accepting writes without the index, so the reclaim rides on neo-agent-brain#128 (FACT).
- `:169` cites `learn/agentos/decisions/0025-*.md` through `0027-*.md` as Engine paths; those ADRs live in neo-agent-brain (FACT).
- `:172` cites `#12679`, transferred: neo-agent-brain#145 (FACT).
- `:289` and `:298`, the claims register, cite the same four references (FACT).

**Out after V-B-A: the roster's model column.** This ticket first said the roster lags the Brain's Model Stats guide (ADR 0012). It is the other way round: the guide is older than the README (Fable 5 vs 5.1, GPT-5.6 Sol vs GPT-6 Astra, no Sophie row), and both say Opus 5 where Ada runs Opus 5.5. Matching the guide would regress the README. The rotation starts in the guide, with each bearer's evidence (lane C), and the README roster follows it.

## The Fix

Through the neo-identity-update protocol:
- FACT fixes from their sources: the 13.2 notes and the Institution README for Agent Institution, GitHub's transfer records for the issue references, and the Brain repository for ADR paths.
- FRAMING against ADR 0018 OD-4 as drafted in #19633 (Body = Engine, Brain = Agent OS backend where nobody lives, Institution = Fleet Manager; the team builds all three). OD-4 is PROPOSED until the operator confirms, so this ticket's PR lands with #19633 or changes with it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] No README or Introduction sentence places the institution or the team inside the Brain or the Agent OS.
- [x] The Fleet Manager (Agent Institution) appears where the README tells a reader how to run a team.
- [x] The Introduction's roster link resolves, and every ADR path and issue reference in the two files points where that record lives now.
- [x] Cross-family review.

## Out of Scope

The ADRs (lane B), the other repositories (C, D), AGENTS.md (E), and the roster's model column (Model Stats first, lane C).
